name: Seafoam Islands & Articuno
summary: Enter the frigid caverns of Seafoam Islands. Push massive boulders through floor fissures with Strength to block raging subterranean rapids on B3F and B4F. Once the torrential currents calm, surf into the deepest inner sanctum to confront the Legendary Ice Bird, Articuno.

items.name: TM07 Hail
items.method: Floor pickup at the eastern edge of the frozen lake on B2F

items.name: Dawn Stone
items.method: Pickup in a narrow northern icy alcove on B1F

items.name: Never-Melt Ice
items.method: Pickup on the central snowy ledge on B3F

items.name: Big Pearl
items.method: Floor pickup after descending the first ladder past the ice wall
